description: User-defined exceptions in Snowflake Scripting: DECLARE ... EXCEPTION, RAISE, and the live-verified uncaught wording Uncaught exception of type 'NAME' on line L at position P : message (the : message tail absent for an argument-less declaration, which defaults to code -20000); an explicit code must be a signed integer literal strictly between -20,999 and -20,000 with the named bounds themselves refused and a computed code a syntax error at the second minus; RAISE of an undeclared name is an invalid identifier; names are case-insensitive; raises work from IF/ELSE/ELSEIF branches, nested IFs and after queries over table data. Converted 1:1 from executor/procedural/UserDefinedExceptionsTest (now retired; the embedded-only ProceduralException.getErrorCode() asserts have no transport surface and are represented by the message pins).
